verdicts.reason: A: the dark header bar doesn't span the canvas. It starts inset from the left and stops about 40px short of the right edge, and the SOLSTICE logo inside it is shrunk to a tiny mark. The two-line headline also sits slightly right of the centre axis, and everything bunches in the top half, leaving a large dead area above the legal text. B keeps a full-width header with the logo at a sensible size and spreads the content down the tall format, but its gaps are uneven: there's a big hole between the headline and the body copy, the divider has moved above the eyebrow, and the legal text is squeezed to near-illegible micro type crowding the bottom edge.
